title: Rewind catalog copy configuration
statement: Let $src$ and $dst$ be indices among the $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be a finite word, and let $d$ be a configuration with a sweep phase. Define a configuration by first applying the forward catalog copy operation to $d$ using a segment of length $|w|$, then setting its phase to rewind and setting the heads on $src$ and $dst$ to their positions in $d$ plus $|w|-1$. All other fields are those of the forward copy configuration.
hypotheses_covered: $src$ and $dst$ are indices among the $k$ work tapes
$d$ is a configuration with a sweep phase
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the exact convention for the buffer representation used by the forward copy operation.
